Sabores Panamá es una empresa de catering con amplia experiencia en la atención de todo tipo de eventos, especializada en la operación de comedores y cafeterías empresariales. Parte 1/3. # RecordAI MVP Definition ## Core Features (The "Must-Haves") To launch the MVP of RecordAI and prove the core value proposition, we will focus exclusively on these 3 features: ### 1. Seamless Audio/Text Ingestion - **Description:** Users can dictate (via voice) or type thoughts, meeting notes, and ideas directly into the app. - **Scope:** - Simple web or mobile interface with a prominent "Record" button. - Integration with a reliable Speech-to-Text API (e.g., OpenAI Whisper) to transcribe

Documento: Reporte OpenClaw: MVP_definition.md. Parte 2/3. audio in near real-time. - Ability to save the raw transcript to the database as a "Conversation". ### 2. Automated Task & Action Item Extraction - **Description:** Once a recording or text input is submitted, the system automatically analyzes the content to find tasks. - **Scope:** - Background processing using an LLM (via the defined NLU prompts). - Identification of explicit tasks and deadlines. - A dedicated "Tasks" view where users can see, edit, and mark these extracted items as complete.

Documento: Reporte OpenClaw: MVP_definition.md. Parte 3/3. ### 3. Basic "Memory" (Context Retention) - **Description:** The system extracts and stores key decisions, facts, and preferences to build a long-term profile of the user/business. - **Scope:** - LLM processing to identify decisions and facts from the transcript. - Storing these items in the `memories` database table. - A simple search or retrieval mechanism so the user can query past decisions (e.g., "What did we decide about the Q3 budget?").
